title: Jais 2: A Family of Arabic-Centric Open Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.13580v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Jais 2 is a family of Arabic-centric large language models developed jointly by MBZUAI, Cerebras, and Inception, designed to advance Arabic-centric language modeling, with strong performance across the Arabic and culturally grounded benchmarks evaluated in this report. The family includes, to our knowledge, the largest open Arabic-centric LLM trained from scratch at 70B parameters, and a competitive 8B-parameter variant among the evaluated open models. A custom Arabic-centric vocabulary enables efficient training and inference. In addition, an optimized architecture and training recipe yield highly compute-efficient training. With a substantially smaller token budget than comparable models, Jais 2 achieves strong Arabic performance on the benchmarks considered in this report and competitive English results. translated_title: Jais 2：一个以阿拉伯语为中心的开放大型语言模型家族
translated_abstract: 摘要：Jais 2 是一个以阿拉伯语为中心的大型语言模型家族，由MBZUAI、Cerebras和Inception联合开发，旨在推进以阿拉伯语为中心的语言建模，在本报告评估的阿拉伯语和文化基准测试中表现出色。该家族包括，据我们所知，目前最大的开源阿拉伯语中心LLM，从头训练的70B参数模型，以及一个在评估的开放模型中具有竞争力的8B参数变体。自定义的阿拉伯语中心词汇表实现了高效的训练和推理。此外，优化的架构和训练配方实现了高度计算高效的训练。与类似模型相比，Jais 2使用显著更小的令牌预算，在本报告考虑的基准测试中取得了强大的阿拉伯语性能和具有竞争力的英语结果。这些模型在OALL2和AraGen上获得了评估的开放模型中的领先结果。它们还在多个文化基准测试中表现强劲。
tldr: Jais 2 通过自定义词汇表和优化架构，以更低的计算成本训练出最大的开源阿拉伯语中心LLM（70B参数），在阿拉伯语和文化基准上取得领先性能。
en_tdlr: Jais 2 achieves leading performance on Arabic and cultural benchmarks with the largest open Arabic-centric LLM (70B parameters), using a custom vocabulary and optimized architecture for compute-efficient training.
